summary.text: TJ Hawthorne is an unaffiliated candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 44B in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic incumbent Leon Lillie.
An engineer and U.S. Navy veteran, he ran in the district as a Libertarian in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: TJ Hawthorne was born in Minneapolis, graduated from North High School, and served in the U.S. Navy from 2001 to 2009, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been an automation engineer for a company based in Oakdale for more than 20 years and has worked as a Department of Defense contractor.
He said he volunteers and sits on the board of his local food shelf.
Hawthorne was the Libertarian candidate in District 44B in 2022, receiving 4.8 percent of the vote in a race won by incumbent Leon Lillie.
He ran again in 2024 and received 5.9 percent, with Lillie again winning.

In the 2026 survey, he named a proposal called Defend the Guard, family court policy, and food regulation among his key messages, and called himself an anti-war veteran whose first priority is Defend the Guard.
